name: Care Twentyone Corporation
summary: Care Twentyone Corporation operates as a comprehensive welfare company in Japan. The company offers home care, paid nursing home, dementia group home, in-home care support, small-scale multi-functional home care, day service, and welfare equipment rental/home renovation services. It also provides support services for people with disabilities; and childcare, home nursing care, home nursing care, medical support, acupuncture and massage, human resource placement and dispatch, lifestyle support, dinning, real estate, and Type A and Type B continuous employment support, as well as employment services for people with disabilities. In addition, the company operates nursing qualification training schools. Care Twentyone Corporation was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
